text: Campaign mode is similar to a linear first-person shooter game, with secrets and bosses.
Adventure mode is an open-ended game where you can explore dungeons, find new towns, gamble for items, etc.
Enter at your own risk! No turning back! For advanced players only!
Flip the switches to activate the bridges
Hit the keys ESDF to move your character.\n\nUse the mouse to look around.
Hit Spacebar to pickup items.\n\nHit C to open your inventory.
To open the door, hit Spacebar while facing it.
Use Mouse button 4 to attack with your melee weapon.
Use Left-click to shoot your gun. Hold right-click to aim and increase your accuracy at the cost of movement speed.
